description:
Join my community & get free value. Take this short survey (takes 1 minute):  https://tally.so/r/RGXj5Q

I'll be offering a free 20-minute call for people who fill in the survey. 

Remotion + Claude Code built this viral reel: a full Netflix vs Blockbuster 
documentary-style collage animation, six scenes, one voiceover, zero After 
Effects and no keyframes.

🎁 All the prompts and asset files are free in my Skool community:
https://www.skool.com/ai-visual-production-lab-4976?utm_campaign=v5

This is the same workflow behind the viral reels you see getting millions of 
views on Instagram and TikTok. In this Remotion tutorial I walk through every 
scene: the collage compositing, the kinetic type, the chart animation, the 
voiceover sync and the final render. No timeline, no manual keyframing, no 
motion designer.

🛠️ Tools used:
Remotion (make videos with React and code): https://remotion.dev
Claude Code: https://claude.com/claude-code

⏱️ Chapters

11:47 The finished reel, knowing how it's made
